// diagnostic

E1254

This project has no `jet dev` entry.

What

This project has no `jet dev` entry.

Why

Project-level `jet dev` (no file argument) runs the entry file's top-level `fn dev()` if it defines one, else `fn run()` (U19, D-JPK-DEVCOMPOSE1). The entry file defines neither.

Fix

add `fn dev() { … }` (a custom dev command) or `fn run() { … }` (the default) to the entry file.
